run_selfchat_vanilla: run a self-chat session using the fixed_response model with a simple response
run_selfchat_convai2: run a self-chat session with the convai2 task and fixed_response model on validation data
run_selfchat_empathetic_dialogues: run a self-chat session with the empathetic_dialogues task using seed messages from the task
test_selfchat_seed_messages: test self-chat by seeding messages from a temporary file and verifying output
